name: Step aside in pauses
description: The screen recording fills the frame and you sit in a round bubble in a corner. When you pause for a breath or longer, the bubble fades out, so the screen has the frame. It fades back just before you speak.
when: Long screen + camera videos, mostly 16:9: demos and walkthroughs where you stop talking while you click or wait for something.
needs: a take with a camera and a screen file
the square of the camera that fills the bubble (the face in its middle)
the corner and the size of the bubble
